An '''antistress capsule''' was a medicinal capsule that [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] secretly slipped between his lips, while [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was momentarily focused on [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] and [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]]. He did this to quell his anxiety at the disappearance of his lieutenant [[Hath Monchar]], whose errant ventures had annoyed the Dark Lord most severely.
